links.outcome: Change in adenoma detection rate of non-AI colonoscopy before vs after AI exposure
links.effect: ADR of standard colonoscopy fell from 28.4% (226/795) to 22.4% (145/648), absolute difference -6.0% (95% CI -10.5 to -1.6; p=0.0089); AI exposure OR 0.69 (0.53-0.89).
links.quote: The ADR of standard colonoscopy decreased significantly from 28·4% (226 of 795) before to 22·4% (145 of 648) after exposure to AI, corresponding with an absolute difference of -6·0% (95% CI -10·5 to -1·6; p=0·0089).

screen.reason: Multicenter observational study investigating clinician deskilling / reliance effects (adenoma detection rate changes on unassisted cases) following deployment and exposure to real-time AI in colonoscopy.
